news.headline: Central Florida Tue Nov 24: Flood Watch in effect for the Treasure Coast, Brevard and Okeechobee Wed 1 AM through Thu 1 AM, River Flood Warning remains in effect and a Coastal Flood Advisory runs Wed 5 AM through Thu 11 AM; Melbourne Tue high 74°F / low 67°F, Wed rain chance 80% — NWS Melbourne river warnings for the St. Johns at Cocoa, Geneva, Astor, DeLand and Sanford remain in Major Flood Stage until further notice

Central Florida builder incentives stay aggressive, updated Nov 23 — benchmark 30-year fixed averaged 7.28% for the week ending Nov 19 (Freddie Mac, up from 7.11%), with Taylor Morrison returning a 4.99% quick move-in offer in Orlando, M/I Homes adding a 4.875% 7/6 ARM, and David Weekley Fall Into Savings live through Nov 30
news.source: Central Florida Builder Incentives Tracker / Freddie Mac PMMS

news.headline: Namdar Group lands $345 million construction loan to build West Brickell rental tower — Commercial Observer: the SCALE Lending loan covers a 42-story, 871,000-square-foot tower at 250 Southwest Seventh Street in Miami with 1,008 apartments, completion expected May 2029, JMA as general contractor

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Comex copper settles 2.74% higher at $5.6270 on Mon Nov 23 — front-month copper for November delivery gained 15.00 cents a pound, settling at $5.6270 after December copper roared back from a bear market intraday, jumping as much as 5.5% to $5.787
news.source: Morningstar / Dow Jones Market Data / Mining.com

news.headline: HVAC manufacturers report increased Q3 revenue — ACHR News Nov 23: Carrier, Trane Technologies and Lennox posted improved residential and commercial revenue, data centers are driving commercial demand with Johnson Controls reporting record backlogs, and contractors face continued price increases from tariffs and high fuel prices

Stocks close sharply higher Mon Nov 23 on Nvidia rally — Nasdaq Composite surged 6.51% to 24,089.56, S&P 500 climbed 4.73% to 7,237.17 and Dow rose 3.01% to 49,595.31, with Nvidia up 31.5% after its board reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive

Mortgage rates Mon Nov 23 — average 30-year fixed is 7.15%, down 0.05% from yesterday, with the 15-year fixed at 6.32%; the Fed held its benchmark steady Oct 28, its next decision is due Dec 9, and Wednesday's PCE inflation report is the week's big watch

NBA Mon Nov 23 — Miami Heat beat the Oklahoma City Thunder 123-113, Bam Adebayo posting a triple-double with 24 points, 15 rebounds and 12 assists for Miami's seventh straight win; Orlando Magic lost at the Washington Wizards 116-96; Magic host the Detroit Pistons Tue Nov 24 in NBA Cup play

NFL Week 11 Sun Nov 22 — all three Florida teams lost: Detroit Lions beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 31-21, Buffalo Bills beat the Miami Dolphins 26-9, and New York Giants beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 23-18
